controller.decay_rule: observed class counts multiply by 2**(-clock_delta / half_life) before each admission decision

mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The service model inherits all E49-E54 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
Wall-time and service half-lives are hand-selected sensitivity points calibrated from this synthetic load range.
Service decay advances on offered candidate prefill work, not realized total GPU occupancy or end-to-end request cost.
The controller still optimizes equal prompt-class acceptance rather than tenant, token, or utility-weighted fairness.
Rejected requests leave immediately and are not retried, routed to another replica, or placed in a reservation class.
model: The E54 rotating-prompt study with gain-4 fairness state decayed by wall time or predicted prefill GPU service.

validation.accounting: The v40 base asserts exact accepted prefill/decode tokens, causal pairs, finite completion only for accepted requests, max batch 64, and KV within budget. Phase counts are exact, decayed accepted weight never exceeds offered weight, every admitted request satisfies its dynamic threshold, and hard slices report zero budget violations.
